01

Scan & join

Scan the QR code on the big screen, type your name — no account, no login — and you're in the lobby.

02

Answer fast

Questions appear on the screen. Tap ∑, π, ∞ or √ on your phone. Faster correct answers earn more points.

03

Claim the podium

The leaderboard reshuffles after every question, and the top three get a finale with their names in lights.

Set up the arena

One question per line: Question | A | B | C | D | correct (1-4) | optional explanation. Lines starting with # are ignored.

How scoring works: a correct answer earns between 50% and 100% of the max points depending on how fast it came in, plus a small streak bonus.

Hosting tip: open this page on the laptop connected to the projector. Phones need to open the same web address, so the file has to be hosted online (see the guide).

Rehearse: the lobby has a button that adds demo players.
